verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a Segment-style event pipeline, so audience building is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows no visual audience or segment builder, no way to define audiences from traits and behavior without code, and no estimated audience size before activation. The closest feature is Profile Builder, which creates warehouse profile records from identify traits or custom JavaScript logic. That is an adjacent, code-based capability and does not count toward this story.
